scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported records cover Swaziland1878–1938 and Eswatini1960–present. Both contain colonial years, so kindregion and dateBasismap_coverage are appropriate.1968independence and2018renaming are distinct. No historical-basemap polygons, modern data, attribution or Asia-assigned content are edited.

The OfficeoftheHistorian short historical summary was read in indexed text. The NationalArchives migrated-archives guide was accessed as a32-page webPDF; relevantSwazilandpage21was read, not the whole archive. It gives1899as the end of SouthAfricanRepublic administration, not1878as its beginning. British arrangements in1902,1903,1964and1967remain distinct. The labelprotectedstateis used for1967without imposing it as the exact legal term for every earlier year.

The AfricanCommission2006mission report was accessed as a32-pagewebPDF and relevant historical paragraphs6–8were read. The opening general-history paragraph citesWikipedia and is not used for early kingdom formation. The1973proclamation and1986succession are cited as historical events.2006political assessments are not projected as an exact2026constitutional account; no present-day health prevalence or law is inferred.

MacDonaldetal2024 was read as indexed Nature full text for the abstract, introduction, Figure2caption and relevant sourcing and chronological results, including Sibebe and Siphiso. A publisherPDF download returned HTML; a university repository copy was challenge-blocked. Neither is represented as a downloaded or fully readPDF. The 2024DAIpressrelease covers the same work and is not used to multiply its200-word public budget. The refined~48,000-year age applies to intensive mining atLionCavern, not every artefact atSibebe. Chemical matches support movement but do not identify a unique exchange mechanism or all final uses. General introductory references to medicine or adhesives elsewhere are not turned into Eswatini treatment claims.

Tintsaba’s sisal and dye pages were read in full indexed text; direct plant-page fetching failed. These are a producer’s accounts of contemporary practices. Sisal is not presented as an ancient indigenous plant. Tea and commercial dye powders are distinguished; public copy does not assert all-natural dyes. Related maker pages share a conservative combined200-word public budget. No named weaver biography is invented from an unread blog title, and no sales-promotion claim of measured poverty reduction is adopted.

Waterford’s historical account and outdoor-learning page were read in indexed main text. These are school retrospectives.1963opening,16initial boys and parentGuedes’s contribution are used; a confusing assertion about a border beingestablishedin1963is excluded. Field trips describe specific school programmes rather than national schooling or all students. The two related pages share a combined200-word public budget.

NgwenyaGlassRecycling was read in full indexed main text; direct fetching failed. Producer claims about recycled material,1987revival and school support are attributed. School collection is not compulsory attendance work and not every bottle is said to have come from children. No emissions, energy-saving percentage, safety practice or independent environmental audit is invented. Historical and programme descriptions share one source budget.

CentralBankCurrency historical banknote and coin sections were read in indexed main text; direct opening failed.1974currency introduction is six years after1968independence. Coin shapes refer to the first issue, not every subsequent denomination. Present rates, present circulating denominations and financial advice are outside scope. The geometry lesson is clearly a playful comparison rather than a recorded educational custom.

The EswatiniTourismAuthorityMantenga description was read directly, including the first three substantive paragraphs. The government’s2012takeover statement was also read as context but not used for a separate word allowance or uncertain hut count. Mantenga is explicitly a reconstructed mid19thcenturyvillage and a modern interpretive/performance setting. No replica is called an untouched historic house, and cultural presentations do not establish uniform past family practices or medical efficacy.

New copy is author-checked pending independent historical-depth review. Structural tests do not certify exhaustive history or border accuracy. Family, learning, work and social performance are included where supported; no toilet custom or medical treatment is fabricated to fill a category.

proposedOverrides.summary: Swaziland became independent from Britain on 6 September 1968. The country adopted the name Eswatini in 2018. These map records cover parts of one continuing regional history, including years before independence.

sharedAssociations.basis: Imported labels and geometry identify the territory called Swaziland and later Eswatini. Both intervals include years before1968independence; the shared regional history distinguishes coverage from sovereignty.
